description: spec/12-apps.md:1737: '/deaddrop CoAP messages MUST use the project's SCHC rule set... Rules for path /deaddrop, content-format 112, and OSCORE options are pre-provisioned... Validation: generator ran, Rust deaddrop_schc integration tests 4/4 passed, targeted Rust rule test passed, and diff checks were clean. Python SCHC suite was attempted but collection is blocked by the pre-existing missing lora_medium dependency. No source change was needed, so no code commit was created.
